title: Good Bones with Ronnie
description: Snazzie FM's call-free health hour. Ronnie reads your health letters aloud and answers each with total confidence and zero medical value. Barry tries to fact-check. Ronnie tells everyone to walk it off.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Welcome to Good Bones, where the letters are real and the advice is mine. First one, Barry.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Gloria writes, quote, my resting heart rate spikes to a hundred and forty sitting still, and my doctor wants tests.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Gloria, congratulations. <p:0.3> That's free cardio. Your heart's getting its steps in. Walk it off, even the numbers out.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie, a hundred and forty sitting down is not a workout. That's a symptom.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Last one, a scary one. Pat writes, quote, I've been dizzy and seeing flashing lights for three days.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Pat, that's a free light show. <p:0.3> Walk it off, ideally over by a window, for the view.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: You can't walk off dizzy, Ronnie. That's how people walk off balconies.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Results are in, Barry. Last week's listener walked it off a curb, <p:0.3> and she's sending this from traction.
